Figure 1: (left) Architectural overview of H-Net with a two-stage hierarchical design (S = 2). (right) Dynamic Chunking (DC). (top-right) Key components of a dechunking layer: (c) a smoothing module for converting discrete chunks into interpolated representations, and (d) an upsampler that restores compressed vectors to their original resolution based on boundary indicators.
